item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
item.description:
Nous Research released Arete-27B, an Apache 2.0 fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B. On Nous’s 803-prompt eval, propaganda answers fell from 22% to 0.9% while Hermes Bench stayed flat at 65.60%.

The post Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9% appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: How to Run NVIDIA Dory 4B with llama.cpp: Loop by Loop Guide
item.description:
Explore a comprehensive coding guide for NVIDIA's Dory 1.0 4B looped language model. Learn how to build the pinned llama.cpp branch, analyze loop-by-loop compute costs, test memory caching, and run paired evaluations.

item.title: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
item.description:
Buoyant has released Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes. It adds declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing and per-tenant metrics, and cut median TTFT 95% in Buoyant’s own benchmark.

The post Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Zyphra ZYFA: FP8 FlashAttention for AMD MI355X, Up to 1.76x Faster
item.description:
Zyphra released ZYFA, open-source FP8 and BF16 prefill attention kernels for AMD Instinct MI355X. On real model activations, its FP8 kernels run 1.16-1.76x faster than AMD’s AITER, with 62-78% lower error at head dimension 128.

The post Zyphra ZYFA: FP8 FlashAttention for AMD MI355X, Up to 1.76x Faster appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.title: Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Small, a 594B MoE With 17B Active
item.description:
Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Small, a 594B-parameter MoE with 17B active parameters. It scores 31 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and runs on Tinker, with Apache 2.0 weights planned.

The post Thinking Machines Releases Inkling 2 Small, a 594B MoE With 17B Active appeared first on MarkTechPost.

item.description:
Google released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a video generation and editing model with native 15-second clips, multi-turn conversational editing and a 30% price cut to $0.07 per second of 720p video.

item.title: Baidu Releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base: A 280B MoE Base Model With 14B Active Parameters
item.description:
Baidu has released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B sparse MoE base model with 14B active parameters, trained on 33.5T tokens and published before any mid- or post-training.
